title: automate-kms-hsm-tls-rotation-private-installer-helm-terraform
author: Diego Chen
release_notes: Automates rotation of TLS certificates and KMS keys for Private Installer deployments. Adds optional HSM-backed KMS integration, Vault sealed-secrets support, Helm and Terraform variables for rotation windows, and upgrade/rollback safety checks.
description: Context: Private deployments require automated key and certificate rotation to meet compliance SLAs and reduce operational toil. This PR adds end-to-end automation for TLS certificate rotation and KMS key material rotation for private-installer deployments using supported KMS backends (cloud KMS, customer-managed HSM via PKCS#11) and Vault for secret distribution. Motivation: reduce manual rotation steps, prevent expired cert outages, and provide a safe upgrade/rollback path for clusters using sealed-secrets or Vault. What this PR does: 1) Installer: adds new CLI flags and helm values to enable rotation workflows, configurable rotation windows, and a dry-run mode. 2) Helm charts: new templates for rotation Jobs, pre-upgrade and post-upgrade hooks, and CRDs for RotationPolicy. 3) Terraform modules: adds optional kms_hsm block, vault_sealed_secrets toggle and resources to wire rotation IAM roles/policies. 4) HSM integration: pluggable PKCS#11 provider config, example HSM connector and tests. 5) Vault: automatic sealed-secrets transcription to Vault when enabled and a reconciler that watches RotationPolicy to trigger Vault rewraps. 6) Rollback safety: prehook validation checks ensure old and new certs co-exist for the configured overlap window; aborts upgrade if validation fails. 7) Operational tooling: adds a CLI command 'installer rotate certs|keys' with --preview and --apply modes that can be used from CI or by SREs. Checklist: - [x] Design doc (Linear ENG-4821) and security review (SEC-201) - [x] Helm templates and values documented - [x] Terraform module updated and versioned - [x] E2E test harness updated - [x] Migration / rollback tested in staging - [x] Runbook updated and added to docs Limitations and opt-in: The HSM flow is opt-in and requires customer-provided PKCS#11 endpoint and credentials; Vault transcription is optional and requires existing Vault instance and policies. Rollout plan: feature will be gated behind a helm value enableRotation=false by default; recommend enabling in non-critical clusters first and gradually rolling out to production after monitoring 2x rotation cycles.

upgrade_notes: When enabling rotation on existing clusters, follow docs/runbooks/rotation.md. Recommended flow: 1) enableRotation: false -> deploy controller 2) dry-run mode for one cycle and review logs 3) enableRotation: true and set overlapWindowDays >= 7 4) monitor rotation metrics and increase overlap if using long-lived connections. The installer provides --preview which logs planned steps without making changes.

notes_for_ops: Default is opt-in: set values.enableRotation to true to opt in
If using HSM: customer must provide PKCS#11 endpoint and create k8s secret with credentialRef
Vault transcription requires vault.address and service account with transcription policies
Monitor metrics rotation_success_rate and rotation_failure_reason in the rotation controller namespace
